title: cleistocalyx arcuatinervius
intro: Cleistocalyx arcuatinervius, commonly known as the curved nerve wood tree, is a species of plant in the family Rutaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cleistocalyx arcuatinervius include its potential to reduce fever, relieve respiratory symptoms, and act as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been found to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
